corrections (label-free, fixed now).C1_element_precedence: For each FR name in snapshot 3: (1) a row of the resolved file with confidence high or medium gives the element fractions; (2) otherwise the legacy data/v2/fr_element_table.csv regex entry; (3) otherwise accepted PubChem formula entries already in the pipeline. Names whose resolved notes say LEGACY CONFLICT use the resolved values (rule 1 wins).
corrections (label-free, fixed now).C2_element_mapping: Resolved columns map to the six pipeline features exactly as the legacy table's columns: el_P = P, el_N = N, el_Si = Si, el_B = B, el_halogen = Cl + Br, el_metal = Al + Mg + Zn (other metals listed in other_elements_wt_pct are added to el_metal). Step 1: self-test - the unchanged pipeline without the chemfix stage reproduces exp115 B 0.3875 [0.3124, 0.5289] and exp116 0.3864 within 0.002 in the same environment; else BLOCKED.

Step 2: one re-score of the exp115 config and the exp116 config with the chemfix stage applied (rescore_loi_snapshot.py with --stage wave4_staging --stage wave5_staging and the chemfix tables; the rescore tool may be extended only to let a stage REPLACE element-table / structure entries, with no other behaviour change, and the step-1 self-test must still pass after the extension).

Report: B mean, 95% material bootstrap CI, pooled CI, protocol A (random split) and protocol C (unseen FR class), as exp115 reports them; paired per-repeat difference vs exp115 (report-only; the snapshot rule, not a gate, decides).
exit_triggers: B ci_lo > 0.84 or A mean > 0.84 -> FLAG (owner wording). Self-test failure -> BLOCKED.
expected (unscored): small: -0.02 to +0.02 on B (fr_structure_resolution.md: structure features still describe under a third of FR mass).
honesty_notes: This is a data-quality correction; any change in R2 is reported as such, never as a model improvement.
Element values from ideal formulas ignore grade and hydration (resolution report caveat).
amendments: BUG FIX, not a choice (2026-10-08, loi_snapshot_update2 basis() precedent), found after the first chemfix re-score (exp113-config B 0.4052, protocol C -1.254; disclosed): rows M123-1 and M123-2 (10.3390/ma16227217) carry fr1_unit 'g (1.5 wt% P in foam)', which mixes the loading basis with a description of the foam's P content. build_loi_rpuf.basis() matches the substring 'wt% p' and treats the 56.1 / 62.5 g loadings as wt% P; with Roflam F5's corrected P fraction (8.5 wt%) this gives total FR 660 / 735 wt% and el_P 56.1 / 62.5. Before chemfix the P fraction was missing, so the bug was hidden (the rows were 'P-basis without P fraction'). The paper's formulation (RF-551 polyol 100 g, Roflam F5 56.1 g / 62.5 g) means grams per 100 g polyol; check: 56.1 g x 8.5% P = 4.8 g P in roughly 340 g of foam = ~1.4 wt% P, consistent with the stated 1.5. Fix: in the chemfix stage only, these two cells are read as 'g (per 100 g polyol)', an existing unit string (11 rows), via a stage-level unit-correction table applied by rescore_loi_snapshot.py; no other row, unit or parser rule changes, and without the chemfix stage the pipeline still reproduces exp115 exactly (self-test repeated). One re-score of both configs follows; that result, after a fresh critic, is the candidate record under this config's rule. The first re-score (0.4052) is kept as history and never used.
